# KODEX CLOUD

KODEX CLOUD is a unified developer platform. Its platform-branded assistant is KODEX AI.

## Main services
- KODEX AI Studio: AI-assisted project and code generation through a background worker.
- Data Cloud: tenant-scoped file storage and dataset listing workflows.
- API Marketplace: API key management and model gateway catalogue.
- Cloud Deploy: service registration and deployment job workflow.
- Code Forge: public/private repository project records.
- Control Center: integration and platform configuration status.

## AI identity
KODEX AI is the assistant identity used by KODEX CLOUD. Operators can connect a self-hosted Ollama-compatible model endpoint or external model APIs. A proprietary trained foundation model exists only after the operator completes model training and deploys the resulting weights.

## Capability notes
Features depend on configured credentials, storage, database, build workers, payment integration, Git hosting and deployment infrastructure. Do not claim integrations are live unless the platform status confirms them.
